name: CIBC Aeroplan Visa Business Card

apr.notes: Purchases 12.99%, 15.99% or 18.99%; cash advances, balance transfers and convenience cheques 14.5%, 17.5% or 21.5%, assigned based on credit.

credit_required.notes: Canadian resident who has reached the age of majority in their province or territory.

base_rate.description: 1 Aeroplan point per $1 on all other purchases.

categories.label: Air Canada direct purchases including Air Canada Vacations
Dining, shipping, internet, cable and phone

rewards.redemption_notes: Aeroplan points redeem for Air Canada and partner flights and other Aeroplan rewards.

notes: The issuer page does not name a network package tier, so network_tier is none. Bonus earn rates apply on the first $80,000 in net annual card purchases on the account. Hyatt earns 1 World of Hyatt bonus point per $1 in addition to Aeroplan points.
